Let there be light

Tag: Setting Agnostic, Creator: Artemys, Mr. Hey

Members of the Keton clan have the unique Plasma release. A powerful combination of Fire and Lightning that grants both devastating and bright shows of power. The clans special release is often called Light release by onlookers and in general social circles. The Keton clan formally works as the Land of Lightnings Storm guard, similar to the Land of Fires Military Police Force, acting as the Cloud villages internal force for law and order.

Keton Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Cha

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Performance, Chakra Control

Plasma Release Affinity: You begin with either Fire or Lightning Release Affinity. (Pick One)

Plasma Techniques: The Keton Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Keton Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Charisma as its casting ability score.

Enlightening Grasp: The Keton clan has the ability to produce light in any object you touch. As a bonus action, you can place your palm on an object no larger than 5 feet in any dimension. For the next 10 minutes, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like. If the object is completely covered in something opaque, the light is blocked. An object cannot be enhanced in this way more than once every hour due to the stress this chakra places on them. You can dismiss the light from as many objects you have affected with this feature at no action.

Keton Features

Stargazer

1st Level Clan Feature

The Keton clan is known as the guiding light within the Land of Lightning. Its north star. The clan achieves this by harnessing the power of Plasma, also known as Stellar Light. You embody this by placing your beacons of light around a battlefield and becoming your teams North Star.

While in combat, once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, you can select a point you can see within 30 feet of you and manifest Starlight, at a chosen point for up to 1 minute. This Starlight is a floating construct of plasma formed of your chakra that sheds a bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

You can maintain up to 4 Starlight’s at once and they are dispelled when combat ends, you spend a Bonus action to dismiss them or you end your movement further than 120 feet away from them. If you create an additional Starlight beyond what you can maintain, the oldest Starlight is dispelled. Effects that can dispel jutsu of the highest rank you can cast, based on your character level can dispel Starlight’s you place. Increase the number of Starlight you can maintain by +1 at 7th and 15th levels. Increase the range you can place a Starlight to 60 feet at 11th level.

While you have Starlight active, you can choose to spend a Bonus action to enter your Solar Flare chakra stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits;

Keton Hijutsu you cast that makes a ranged attack, or ranged attacks you make with the Plasma Burst attack, can originate from one of your active Starlight’s.

When you take the Attack action while in this stance, you can replace attacks made with this action with either a Stellar Knuckle or Plasma Burst attack. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, then beginning at 7th level, you can make two attacks with either of these attacks, instead of one.

Stellar Knuckle. Make a melee attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus as the limb you strike with is imbued with Plasma energy. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + your jutsu ability modifier in fire damage.

Plasma Burst. Make a ranged attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet as you fire a bolt of plasma like chakra at a creature. On a hit you deal 1d12 fire damage.

Stellar Convergence

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Keton clan is not just able to wield light, they become it. They are able to illuminate and obliterate anything in their path to victory. You learn to harness this willpower and fighting spirit, in the form of Stellar Charges, releasing it as precise bursts of plasma.

You have a number of Stellar Charges equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You begin combat with 0 Stellar Charges, and you cannot gain them outside of combat. You can gain 1 Stellar Charges per trigger, per turn, from the following;

When you deal damage to a hostile creature.

When you take damage from a hostile creature.

When you begin your turn and maintain concentration on a Keton Hijutsu.

You provide a bonus to an allied creatures attack or damage rolls.

You can spend Stellar Charges, on Constellations, of which you begin with 2. You gain an additional Constellation at 7th and 15th level. Constellations that force a saving throw or make an attack, use your highest jutsu save DC or attack bonus for its calculation.

Sazanami – The Ripple

Your light radiates like ripples in the sky, supercharging a Starlight in range. As a bonus action, by spending 2 Stellar Charges you can select one Starlight you have active, as it becomes supercharged and flashes a blinding unstable white light. All creatures within 10 feet of this Starlight must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain 1 rank of Dazzled and becomes a Convergence for the next minute.

Beginning at 7th level, you can select two different Starlight’s as this abilities point of origin. Beginning at 15th level, creatures that fail, gain 2 ranks of Dazzled.

Urashima – The Fisherman

You can direct the radiance of your starlight’s towards an ally, marking them as your bait for the next fish caught in your trap. As a bonus action, by spending 1 Stellar Charges you can select one allied creature within 60 feet of you. Until the beginning of your next turn, that ally begins glowing with a soft plasma like light and can reroll one attack roll or check they make, taking the new result. If a hostile creature makes a melee attack against the chosen ally, all Starlight’s within 60 feet can trigger at your discretion. If you let them, you can spend your reaction, and all Starlight’s fire a Plasma Burst, at the triggering creature. Make an attack for each triggering Starlight.

Beginning at 7th level, the select ally gains a +2 bonus to their AC and their next saving throw for the duration. Beginning at 15th level, You can target two allies with this feature, instead of one. You also gain an additional Reaction, which you can only use to trigger this features Starlight attacks.

Kagayaki – The Glittering

The light you manifest begins to glitter as you bend it around an ally, guiding them to victory. As a bonus action, by spending 2 Stellar Charge you can select one allied creature within 60 feet of you. That ally can move up to their speed, and then can spend their Reaction to cast a Jutsu of their choice. If the jutsu forces a saving throw, on a failure against a hostile creature, on a failure the hostile creature becomes a Convergence for the next minute. If the jutsu does not force a saving throw but still affects a hostile creature, then the hostile creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they become a Convergence for the next minute.

Beginning at 7th level, the select ally creature can instead choose to spend 10 feet of their movement to teleport into a space closest to one of your Starlight’s. Beginning at 15th level, if you instead spend 3 Stellar Charges, to activate this Constellation it no longer costs a Bonus action, if you do, you cannot use this feature again the same turn.

Tokaichi – The Market

You bend a field of plasma around a hostile creature, attempting to escape from your radiance. As part of casting a Keton Hijutsu, you can reshape the jutsu’s range of effect by spending 2 Stellar Charges. Select one of the following shapes, all of which now originates from a Starlight of your choice, allowing your jutsu to now begin from unconventional locations. The new shape now forces all creatures in range make a Dexterity saving throw, suffering the effects of your chosen jutsu on a failure, or half damage (if any) on a success.

20-Foot Cube.

10-Foot Radius, that goes around corners.

30-Foot long, 5 foot wide, line.

30-foot cone.

Beginning at 7th level, you can place a Starlight as part of this Constellation. If you do, this effect originates from that new Starlight. Beginning at 15th level, if a creature making their saving throw is a Convergence, they make their saving throw at disadvantage, and doesn’t end the Convergence condition as normal.

Mikogami – The Shrine Maiden

You scatter your Plasma energy into a diffuse haze of light and interference, obscuring your allies from hostile perception. As a reaction to an allied creature taking damage from an attack, you can spend 2 Stellar Charges, to spread this blinding light between your ally and the triggering creature. Roll 1d6, reducing the triggering attack total by the result, potentially causing the attack to miss. If the triggering attack is part of a jutsu with multiple attacks, all subsequent attacks that are part of the jutsu takes a 1d4 penalty to their attack results.

Beginning at 7th level, If the result on the d6 is a 6, then the attacking creature becomes a Convergence for the next minute. Beginning at 15th level, the subsequent attacks now roll a d6 penalty, instead of a d4.

Karasuki – The Plow

You compress and release built up stellar energy into bursts of power. When you take the Attack action and make a Stellar Knuckle or Plasma Burst attack or cast a Keton Hijutsu that deals damage, you can spend 1 Stellar Charge to magnify their power. Increase the damage you deal with them by +2, until the end of the current turn. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level.

Aphelion – The Mirror

You channel compressed Plasma into a shield of light, protecting yourself or an allied creature from fatal harm. As a reaction to damage being dealt to you or an allied creature you can see that is within 20 feet of a Starlight. The protected creature gains 3d6 temporary hit points, and the attacking creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are Blinded until the beginning of your next turn. Increase the temporary hit points gained to 5d6 at 7th level and 7d6 at 15th level.

For the duration you gain the following benefits. You gain additional benefits based on the number of Starlight’s consumed. / Stellar Presence. Creatures within 40 feet of you cannot gain the benefits of being invisible you gain immunity to the Blinded and Dazzled conditions. / Transcendent Charge. At the beginning of each of your turns, you can summon 2 Starlight’s instead of one. / Infinite Horizon. Once per round, on your turn, you can gain 2 Stellar Charges, from any one trigger of your choice. / Starlight’s Consumed / 1 Starlight. Plasma Release Manifestation

7th Level Clan Feature

The Keton clan has a unique talent for manifesting Plasma Release due to their close affinity to both Fire and Lightning Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Plasma Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Fire or Lightning release keywords, you can change the damage type to Fire or Lightning respectively.

Additionally, you exemplify your clans principles and status as a guiding light. The North star for your team. When socializing with creatures native to the Land of Lightning or with knowledge of your clans station in the Cloud village, you gain a 2 ranks of Mastery to all social checks made against them as you are able to lead the conversation with no fear of it falling apart.

Plasma Fission/Fusion

11th Level Clan Feature

You have learned to modify your Starlight’s to becomes beacons of your victory. Your Starlight’s now have two new states they can be in either Starlight Fission or Starlight Fusion. At the beginning of your turn, instead of creating a new Starlight, you can choose to select a currently active Starlight to enter either its Fission or Fusion state. Either form

Starlight Fission. Your Starlight becomes an unstable mass of energy, that bubbles and looks to be going nuclear until the beginning of your next turn, after which, it explodes. All hostile creatures that begin their turn within 20 feet of the chosen Starlight are hit with a wave of chakra fueled radiation, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain Convergence, and either 3 ranks of Dazzled, Weakened, or Concussed. At the beginning of your next turn, the chosen Starlight explodes, filling a 20-foot radius, forcing all creatures in range to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire or lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

Starlight Fusion. You select two active Starlight’s, as they are attracted to one another, and begin to fuse, becoming a super mote until the beginning of your next turn. Select a new point within 120 feet of you, where both Starlight’s converge upon. This new Fused Starlight, glows bright light in a 40-foot radius, and dim light for an additional 40 feet. Effects that originate from this Fused Starlight gain a rank of Mastery to its attack result, and a +1 bonus to its Save DC. You can increase this bonus to 2 ranks of Mastery and a +2 bonus by fusing one additional active Starlight.

Event Horizon

15th Level Clan Feature

You have become not just the guiding light, but instead the gold standard within your clan. Your control, power and skill with Plasma release is unmatched. You have found a way to make your body act as a focal point similar to that of actual stars. By spending a Bonus Action, 4 Stellar Charges, and consuming up to 4 Starlight’s your body becomes wreathed in superheated plasma chakra as you reach an Event Horizon only dreamed of. You remain in this Event Horizon state for up to 1 minute. Each Starlight consumed is dispelled. Once you exit this state you cannot reenter it until you complete a long rest.
